Use case: illustration-story. Asset: production game animation atlas, exactly 4 columns by 4 rows, 16 equal square cells on a 2048x2048 true transparent canvas. No grid lines, labels, typography, panels, shadows, scene or background.
REFERENCE 1 is the authoritative Vanguard squirrel character, preserve the exact gold helmet and clear round visor, orange/white face, big brown eyes, gold rectangular A chest plate, white astronaut suit, black knee pads and cuffs, same backpack and huge thick orange/brown/cream striped tail. Create a carefully registered upright full-body turnless animation asset of that exact Vanguard. He always faces screen right in the SAME 3/4 view. Same camera, lighting, head diameter, fur color, helmet, body height, suit markings, tail mass and position, backpack in ALL SIXTEEN CELLS. Never grow/shrink him. Helmet remains seated, no independent drift. Feet share a single baseline in each cell; leave at least 30px margin on ALL sides including tail, pants, ears and feet. His posture is upright standing/walking, NOT flying. Every frame must fit its cell. Each hand only five digits or fewer.
The gag: the squirrel is ALWAYS FULLY DRESSED in his white suit and pulls a SEPARATE SPARE PAIR OF WHITE PANTS with PURPLE waistband/side trim/knee pads out of the front of his suit, holds them up, laughs very hard, folds them and stuffs them back INSIDE his suit. No undressing, no extra character, no bear in the sheet, no pants on ground. The spare pair is always the SAME pair, with TWO connected pant legs and waistband. The prop becomes completely absent by the last cell. All poses should be full drawings, not separated parts.
ROW 1 left to right: four readable grounded WALK-CYCLE phases in place toward screen right, right-foot contact; right passing under hips; left-foot contact; left passing. Gently alternating legs and arms, SAME standing torso, tail maintained. No props.
ROW 2 left to right: stops, looks down and opens front waist pocket with both paws; pulls a small folded bundle of white/purple spare trousers halfway out of pocket; unfolds spare trousers to half length with both paws; holds the fully unfolded spare trousers by the two waistband corners just in front of body, keeps his own suited legs visible.
ROW 3 left to right: four consecutive belly-laugh poses holding that SAME pair of trousers at both waistband corners, wide open smiling mouth with cheek lift; then eyes squint with shoulders raised; then head tilted back just slightly and eyes squeezed shut laughing hard; then head returns, cheeks up, mouth broad laugh. Energetic laughter driven by expressive face and shoulders, NOT by character size or stretching. Tail still full stable shape, feet planted, pants stable length.
ROW 4 left to right: laughter ends, brings pant legs upward to fold them; same pants folded to compact bundle between both paws at waist; pushes folded bundle halfway into front waist pocket with both paws; empty paws release from pocket, standing contented grin, NO visible spare pants, ready to walk away.
